prompt.zh-TW: 木岸家具今年本期進貨 {{money:vars.purchases}}，年底應付帳款 {{money:vars.ap}}。依課程 Excel 版（分子用本期進貨、分母用期末餘額）計算應付款項週轉率，以「次」作答。
prompt.en: Woodbank Furniture made purchases of {{money:vars.purchases}} this year and had trade payables of {{money:vars.ap}} at year end. Using the course Excel version (purchases over the closing balance), what is the payables turnover? Answer in times.

explanation.zh-TW: Excel 版的{{term:tm_2jyfy0hn}}＝{{term:tm_p7h3c5xq}} ÷ {{term:tm_a3p9y6kc}}，表示一年之中欠供應商的貨款「欠了再付清」大約轉了幾輪。這個版本對上課程的 Excel 答案。
explanation.en: In the Excel version, {{term:tm_2jyfy0hn}} = {{term:tm_p7h3c5xq}} ÷ {{term:tm_a3p9y6kc}}: roughly how many times a year the amounts owed to suppliers are run up and paid off. This version matches the course Excel answers.
